findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.openany.si" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api, openany_overview · Private data: run_api · Public sink: run_api · Destructive: get_api, run_api.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api, openany_overview · Private data: run_api · Public sink: run_api · Destructive: get_api, run_api

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
